name: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)
excerpt: The Work Breakdown Structure is a deliverable-oriented grouping of project work defining the total scope.
notes:
The Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) is a deliverable-oriented grouping of the work involved in a project that defines the total scope of the project. It breaks down all work into discrete tasks and is presented in graphical or tabular form. A good WBS is mutually exclusive and completely exhaustive.

The WBS 100% Rule states that once all work for the work packages is completed, the project should be done. Work packages are deliverables, and interim deliverables are needed to create the final product but are discarded after project completion.
context_summary:
- A deliverable-oriented grouping of project work.
- Defines the total scope of the project.
- Breaks down work into discrete tasks.
- Presented in graphical or tabular form.
- Follows the 100% Rule for project completion.
